request.text: Check tomorrow evening's weather in Hangzhou so I can decide whether to keep my outdoor dinner with Kai, and remind me at 5:30 this afternoon to text Kai our final plan.

responsibilities.outcome: Report tomorrow evening's weather in Hangzhou for the user's outdoor dinner with Kai.
Create a 5:30 PM today reminder to text Kai the final plan.

new_goals.description: Obtain and report Hangzhou weather for tomorrow evening's outdoor dinner with Kai.
new_goals.source_text: Check tomorrow evening's weather in Hangzhou so I can decide whether to keep my outdoor dinner with Kai
constraints: Use Hangzhou as the forecast location.
Use tomorrow evening as the forecast period.
success_criteria: The user receives a grounded forecast relevant to deciding the dinner plan.

new_goals.description: Create a 5:30 PM today reminder to text Kai the final plan.
new_goals.source_text: remind me at 5:30 this afternoon to text Kai our final plan
constraints: Schedule the reminder for 5:30 PM today.
Preserve Kai and the final plan in the reminder subject.
success_criteria: One reminder is created with the requested time and subject.

semantic_facts: Keep the weather lookup and reminder creation as separate Goal-owned steps; they may run concurrently, then report only grounded weather and reminder evidence.
forbidden_claims: The assistant invents a forecast, claims the reminder succeeded without trusted evidence, or claims it texted Kai.

target.claim_boundary: assistant-authored candidate oracle; not independently reviewed

negative_hypotheses: The forecast and reminder Goals are collapsed because both support one dinner decision.
The Planner sends Kai a message, omits a Capability, or serializes independent steps without need.
